     28| ext_mod = import_module("16_external_val")
     29| PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
     30| REPORT_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / "reports"; REPORT_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
     31| DEVICE = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
     32| N_FOLDS = 5
     33| CKPT_BINARY = PROJECT_ROOT / "checkpoints" / "binary"
     34| 
     35| 
     36| # ---------- DeLong (Sun & Xu 2014 fast) ----------
     37| def compute_midrank(x):
     38|     J = np.argsort(x); Z = x[J]; N = len(x)
     39|     T = np.zeros(N); i = 0
     40|     while i < N:
     41|         j = i
     42|         while j < N and Z[j] == Z[i]: j += 1
     43|         T[i:j] = 0.5 * (i + j - 1) + 1
     44|         i = j
     45|     T2 = np.empty(N); T2[J] = T
     46|     return T2
     47| 
     48| 
     49| def delong_test(preds_a, preds_b, labels):
     50|     """iki korelasyonlu AUROC farki. return (aucA, aucB, z, p)."""
     51|     labels = np.asarray(labels)
     52|     pos = labels == 1; neg = labels == 0
     53|     m, n = pos.sum(), neg.sum()
     54|     preds = np.vstack([preds_a, preds_b])
     55|     tx = np.array([compute_midrank(preds[r, pos]) for r in range(2)])
     56|     ty = np.array([compute_midrank(preds[r, neg]) for r in range(2)])
     57|     tz = np.array([compute_midrank(preds[r]) for r in range(2)])
     58|     aucs = (tz[:, pos].sum(1) - m * (m + 1) / 2) / (m * n)
     59|     v01 = (tz[:, pos] - tx) / n
     60|     v10 = 1 - (tz[:, neg] - ty) / m

--- 06_metrics.py
      1| #!/usr/bin/env python3
      2| """
      3| 06_metrics.py
      4| PCG Q1 Manuscript — CirCor 2022 resmi + tamamlayici metrikler.
      5| 
      6| Hasta-duzeyi degerlendirme. Sinif sirasi: Present=0, Unknown=1, Absent=2.
      7| 
      8| Metrikler:
      9|   - weighted_accuracy : RESMI challenge metrigi (Present=5, Unknown=3, Absent=1)
     10|   - macro_f1          : sinif-dengeli F1
     11|   - uar               : Unweighted Average Recall (= macro recall)
     12|   - per_class_recall, confusion_matrix, sensitivity/specificity yardimcilari
     13| 
     14| Resmi W.acc formulu (Reyna et al. 2022; arxiv 2509.18424 Eq.7):
     15|   W.acc = (5*tp + 3*tu + 1*ta) / (5*cp + 3*cu + 1*ca)
     16|   tp/tu/ta : ilgili sinifta DOGRU tahmin sayisi (confusion diagonali)
     17|   cp/cu/ca : ilgili sinifin GERCEK toplam sayisi (confusion satir toplami)
     18| 
     19| Not: Resmi koddaki confusion matrix yonelimi [gercek, tahmin]; diagonal dogru
     20| tahminler. Payda gercek-sinif toplamlari uzerinden agirliklanir.
     21| """
     22| from __future__ import annotations
     23| import numpy as np
     24| 
     25| # resmi sinif sirasi ve agirliklar
     26| CLASSES = ["Present", "Unknown", "Absent"]
     27| WEIGHTS = np.array([5.0, 3.0, 1.0])   # Present, Unknown, Absent
     28| N_CLASSES = 3
     29| 
     30| 
     31| def confusion_matrix(y_true: np.ndarray, y_pred: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
     32|     """[gercek, tahmin] yonelimli 3x3 confusion matrix."""
     33|     y_true = np.asarray(y_true).astype(int)
     34|     y_pred = np.asarray(y_pred).astype(int)
     35|     cm = np.zeros((N_CLASSES, N_CLASSES), dtype=np.int64)
     36|     for t, p in zip(y_true, y_pred):
     37|         cm[t, p] += 1
     38|     return cm
     39| 
     40| 
     41| def weighted_accuracy(y_true: np.ndarray, y_pred: np.ndarray) -> float:
     42|     """RESMI CirCor 2022 weighted accuracy.
     43|     Pay  : agirlikli dogru tahminler (diagonal).
     44|     Payda: agirlikli gercek-sinif toplamlari (satir toplamlari)."""
     45|     cm = confusion_matrix(y_true, y_pred)
     46|     correct = np.diag(cm).astype(float)          # [tp, tu, ta]
     47|     class_totals = cm.sum(axis=1).astype(float)  # [cp, cu, ca]
     48|     num = float((WEIGHTS * correct).sum())
     49|     den = float((WEIGHTS * class_totals).sum())
     50|     return num / den if den > 0 else 0.0
     51| 
     52| 
     53| def per_class_recall(y_true: np.ndarray, y_pred: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
     54|     cm = confusion_matrix(y_true, y_pred)
     55|     correct = np.diag(cm).astype(float)
     56|     totals = cm.sum(axis=1).astype(float)
     57|     return np.divide(correct, totals, out=np.zeros_like(correct),
     58|                      where=totals > 0)
     59| 
     60|

--- 49_reciprocal_transfer.py
      1| #!/usr/bin/env python3
      2| """
      3| 49_reciprocal_transfer.py
      4| RECIPROCAL (cift-yonlu) cross-dataset transfer — Hakem-onleyici, yon-asimetrisi testi.
      5| 
      6| Mevcut makale: CirCor (egit) -> CinC/Yaseen (test).  [ileri yon]
      7| Bu script:     CinC   (egit) -> CirCor (test) + Yaseen (test).  [ters yon]
      8| 
      9| NEDEN sadece CinC<->CirCor (Yaseen egitime SOKULMAZ):
     10|   - CinC ve CirCor ikisi de GENEL normal/abnormal etiketli -> etiket tanimi uyumlu.
     11|   - Yaseen 5 spesifik KAPAK hastaligi -> Yaseen'de egitmek "kapak dedektoru" yapar,
     12|     "genel-anormal dedektoru" degil; CirCor'a transferi etiket-uyusmazligini olcer,
     13|     domain shift'i DEGIL. Bu yuzden Yaseen yalniz TEST hedefi olarak kalir.
     14|   - CinC'te patient_id YOK -> kayit-disjoint 5-fold (her kayit bagimsiz; CinC std.).
     15| 
     16| ORIJINAL checkpoint'leri EZMEZ: checkpoints/reciprocal_cinc/ 'e yazar.
     17| 
     18| Kullanim:
     19|   python 49_reciprocal_transfer.py --model cnn_bilstm
     20|   python 49_reciprocal_transfer.py --model mambaconformer
     21| """
     22| from __future__ import annotations
     23| import argparse, time, json
     24| from pathlib import Path
     25| from importlib import import_module
     26| from collections import deque
     27| import numpy as np
     28| import pandas as pd
     29| import torch
     30| import torch.nn as nn
     31| from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, WeightedRandomSampler
     32| from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score, confusion_matrix
     33| 
     34| ev = import_module("16_external_val")
     35| ds_mod = import_module("05_dataset")
     36| me_mod = import_module("06_metrics")
     37| PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
     38| DEVICE = ev.DEVICE
     39| N_FOLDS = 5
     40| RANDOM_STATE = 42
     41| 
     42| # ileri yon (mevcut makale) referans degerleri — karsilastirma icin
     43| FORWARD = {
     44|     "cnn_bilstm":     {"cinc": 0.727, "yaseen": 0.806},   # CirCor->X
     45|     "mambaconformer": {"cinc": 0.601, "yaseen": 0.985},
     46| }
     47| 
     48| 
     49| def make_cinc_folds(manifest_csv, out_csv):
     50|     """CinC kayit-disjoint stratified 5-fold (patient_id yok -> kayit bazli)."""
     51|     from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
     52|     df = pd.read_csv(manifest_csv).reset_index(drop=True)
     53|     skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=N_FOLDS, shuffle=True, random_state=RANDOM_STATE)
     54|     fold = np.full(len(df), -1, dtype=int)
     55|     ybin = (df["label"] == "abnormal").astype(int).values
     56|     for fi, (_, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(df, ybin)):
     57|         fold[val_idx] = fi
     58|     df["fold"] = fold
     59|     df.to_csv(out_csv, index=False)
     60|     return df
